turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: You’ll need to show your work order at the door.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: Show your badge or I don’t sign for anything. Stand at ease.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: Internal’s handled by the blue team—leave your badge at the door.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: First night for you too, huh? Name’s Bram, guard’s the last word here.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: Hand it here. I’ll check and hand it back if you’re on the list.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Hmm, let me take a look. Step back.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: No badge? Then you’re not going in. Try again.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: Vasquez? Last saw him patrolling sector 7—check with Lieutenant Brandt.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Ask for the building if you're expecting someone—name doesn’t open doors here.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Lind isn’t here to authorize you. Stand back.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: That’s above my pay grade, friend.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Not your concern, visitor. Check the logs if you must know.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: That's classified, friend. Next?

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Seven years and counting. Who wants to know?

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: If you got tools, come on in—otherwise, stand aside. The night’s long, and I’m beat.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: I don’t care about uniforms. Show me your badge.

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: No one opens this door but the chief. Move along.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: Hands stay where they are, and you’re not paid for that.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: You’re not on my shift list, pal. Step back or I’ll log you as trespassing.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: Midnight shift isn't for dancing monkeys, pal—go home.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: Well, you’re not on the shift list, are ya?

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: Show your work order. And you’re not the plumber I see.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Show me your badge first, or I won’t open this door.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: I see no ID, so that’s just noise.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: At dawn, but you’re not getting in until then.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: Ask who, or don’t bother—no one’s here but you and me.

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: You'll have to go through me first.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: Vasquez? Not tonight.
